text: • Track body weight and measurements, and keep private progress photos to compare side by side.
page: Google Play store listing draft, full description (FULL23, under SEE YOUR PROGRESS)
proof: Code read: Measures page holds body weight, measurements and photos (measures/index.tsx:2-7); photos are copied into the app's own folder progress-photos/ (progressPhotos.ts:4-14,48); Compare screen shows two photos side by side (photos/compare.tsx:2); the server keeps only a photo's day, not the photo (0032_member_cloud.sql:21; 0040_gym_mate_profiles.sql:23 says there is no member-photo storage). Test L01-backup-rules.test.ts:114-117 checks cloud backup leaves progress-photos/ out. Limit on 'private': if the member turns on 'Include photos in my backup' (default off) copies go into photo-backup/, which Android's backup to the member's own Google account includes (progressPhotos.ts:8-10; forgeai_backup_rules.xml:15-18,35), and a phone-to-phone transfer carries the full photos (forgeai_data_extraction_rules.xml:50). Tests not run in this step; side-by-side compare has no test that I opened.

text: Logging your workouts is free, and there are no ads.
page: Google Play store listing draft, full description (FULL40, closing line)
proof: 'Free' half: the paid list is exactly watch, olderCharts, weightSuggestions, calculators, ownExercises (packages/theme/src/memberPlan.ts:56-57), pinned by test apps/mobile/test/plan/memberPlanRules.test.ts:47; logging is not on it, and the in-app Plus page lists 'Log every workout, with no limit' under 'Free for everyone, always' (planWords.ts:20-22). The only gate calls in the app are for weightSuggestions and calculators (targetStore.ts:141,172; exercise/[id].tsx:479; one-rep-max.tsx:33; ExerciseLogCard.tsx:940). 'No ads' half: a search of apps/mobile (package.json, app config, AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle, src) and the whole repo outside docs/ for admob, google-mobile-ads, gms.ads, AD_ID, BannerAd, InterstitialAd found nothing, so no ad code exists today; but no test or check would fail if an ad library were added, and the merged manifest of a built app was not inspected.
